title: How a Godly Man Stays the Same Man in Every Room
caption:
A godly man doesn't have a church face. He's the same guy in the group chat.

Check your feed against your room. Watch what you laugh at when no one's grading you for it. Finish the job no one will ever check. Let your prayers match your Monday, not just your Sunday.

Whatever you do, work at it as for the Lord, not for people. One man, every room. That's the whole assignment.

#faith #integrity #godlymen #christianman #discipleship #manofgod #character
